verdict.rationale: A filing agency could plausibly offer a system-to-system channel, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing web filing: the Annual Report Wizard, online entity filing, an 'Authorized Users' UCC/EFS e-filing system with no stated machine interface or enrollment path, and Commercial Registered Agent registration, which is an adjacent role rather than a transmitter or batch program. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, no llms.txt and no documented public API, so nothing documents a system account, transmitter or batch channel with a published enrollment path.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
